Which graphics API the game uses. Takes effect the next time you launch the game, not live.

OpenGL ES (default): the native renderer written for this port. It works on every device tested so far — start here, and only change it if you have a reason to.

OpenGL ES + ANGLE: the same renderer, routed through Google's ANGLE (which translates it to Vulkan) instead of your phone's own GLES driver. Often faster once running.

Vulkan: the original backend, through DXVK's Direct3D 8 to Vulkan translation. Usually faster on recent Snapdragon phones, but it depends entirely on your GPU driver, and some drivers render it incorrectly.

If the game runs but the screen is black, the device log names the backend it actually used: look for "INFO: Creating SDL3 … window" and "[d3d8gles] GLES backend" in generals-stderr.log in the game folder.
